title: Key rack
about: a 160 mm rack with five tilted pegs, a pattern with a param count, hung on two keyhole slots with tapered seats
tries: Add a small shelf above the pegs for post and sunglasses | Put a ball on each peg's tip so rings cannot slide off

agent.role: a designer of hall and entryway fittings who writes repeats as patterns with param counts
agent.prompt: Prefer patterns whose count and step are params, and positions written from them; keep pegs at least 6 mm thick; never let a keyhole or its seat run into a peg.

fragments.fixing: Report the screw spacing 2 * kx in millimetres whenever n or step changes.
fragments.load: For bags or leads, suggest PETG and pegs 10 mm thick.
